verdict.rationale: Godot documents a first-party scriptable editor surface. EditorInterface can save and reload scenes and inspect or edit resources and objects, EditorScript's _run() executes custom editor code, and plugins can be written in GDScript. Builds are covered by a documented CLI and the `godot --headless` binary, which the runtime probe confirms handles CI builds, exports, and scripted editor automation. missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating nodes and setting properties from an external headless invocation (EditorScript is shown run from the editor's File > Run menu), any official agent-facing protocol (no official MCP exists, only fragmented community servers), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven editor control.
